reason: The ingested official player-stat feed contains season-to-date leaders, not per-game logs joined by team and week. A correlation computed from season totals would be a correlation of 32 aggregate points, not of game outcomes. Refusing to publish it is the honest output; see Q08 and the method page.
whatIsNeeded: Per-player game logs (WK / OPP / stat columns), which nfl.com publishes on each player page. That ingest is the next task and is not claimed as done here.

demonstration.label: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION — simulated numbers, not any real player
demonstration.reading: Shows the interval machinery: with 24 observations a strong simulated relationship still has a wide interval.
